# Bayu Rifki Alghifari - Full Stack Web Developer

> Bayu Rifki Alghifari is a professional Full Stack Web Developer and software engineer from Indonesia specializing in Laravel, React, Vue.js, PHP, Golang, and Node.js. He designs and develops high-performance web applications, scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and responsive frontends.

## Featured Portfolio Projects
- **Sikelim (Kemkes)**: Medical waste management information system for the Ministry of Health Republic of Indonesia (Laravel, Vue 2).
- **FTTH Platform**: Fiber To The Home platform for Internet Service Providers (Kotlin, React).
- **IPTV Management System (CMS & Forty TV)**: Hospitality IPTV management platform for hotel systems (Laravel, Livewire, Android Compose).
- **Topup & PPOB Platform**: Game voucher and bill payment transaction system (Laravel, Vue 3).
- **TAXIe**: On-demand ride-hailing and multi-service platform (Laravel, React).
- **CBT Online**: Computer-Based Testing and examination platform (Laravel, Next.js).
- **Adaptasi KLHK**: Climate change adaptation portal for Ministry of Environment and Forestry (Laravel, Vue 2).
- **Koperasi Simpan Pinjam**: Financial cooperative credit and savings management web app (Laravel, Next.js).
